project.name: RecallZero
project.summary: An autonomous product-safety agent that identifies owned products, verifies exact CPSC recall matches, and completes remedy workflows through verified resolution.
project.ai_usage: Strands agents interpret authoritative recall records and plan governed actions behind deterministic identity and completion gates.
project.codex_usage: Codex is used to scope, implement, test, verify, and prepare the submission in a fresh repository during the competition period.
